description:
Browser where your favorite apps won't get buried in tabs.


🍪 Biscuit Release Note

⚡️New features
- Translate pages on your device in English, Japanese, German, Spanish, French, Korean, Portuguese, and Simplified or Traditional Chinese. Page text is never sent to a translation service.
- Translate from the toolbar or right-click menu in normal tabs, Link Preview, and split views. Choose your preferred language, correct the detected page language, or return to the original text.
- Download and manage language packs, see which packs are already downloaded, and translate offline after the required packs are installed.

💪🏻Improvements
- Remember your preferred translation language across pages and restarts.
- Keep forms, editable text, and code unchanged while translating, and preserve links and text formatting where they can be mapped safely.
- Updated Electron to 43.8.7.

🐞Bug
- Fixed technical English pages failing to start translation when language detection was uncertain.
- Prevented isolated words with empty translations from stopping the entire page translation or disappearing.
- Fixed a crash on Linux Wayland when a hidden window is used as the parent.
